name: [UPDATE] Transformers: Prime
desc:
Inspired by the 2010-2013 show, Transformers: Prime, and additional Transformers media. Play as Optimus, Megatron, Bumblebee, and many more! Look out for updates with characters and game mechanics in the future! Join Sector 7, the Transfans group on roblox, or follow me for updates! This game is compatible with mobile devices, but recommend that you play on PC or Console 

Developers: Markforge, RoboTRONFan, 7otal_Blackout, BlackConvoy, AshCraft, DoomBinger, Robertblox Contributors: GeneralCrocket, PrimeFire94, Lewa1267 I do not own and am not affiliated with the Transformers brand. I do not profit from this game. All rights belong to Hasbro and Takara Tomy
